note: Generated by art/slice_pack2.py from art/source/pack2/*. Paths are relative to this file. Hair, outfits and shoes (full-resolution slices, not shipped; the game uses the game-size sprites made from them) are in art/sprites/pack2/manifest.json, the accessories in dist/assets/pack2/manifest.json. Same conventions as ../items/views/manifest.json: views front, left (figure faces viewer-left), right (faces viewer-right), back; source.box = [x, y, w, h] in sheet px including the 2px padding, sprite px = sheet px unless the view has a 'scale' (none at present); all four views of an item come from one sheet row at one drawing scale, and scaleRef restates their relative size and vertical alignment (rowTop/rowBottom = union of the four boxes; per view dy = box top - rowTop, bottomGap = rowBottom - box bottom, heightVsFront = h / front h). source.column = 0-based sheet column (long-waves has its side columns swapped on the sheet). parts: offset = position of the part inside the view's sprite; left/right = viewer's left/right. faceHole (hair front only) as in ../items/manifest.json. replaces = the item redraws the same id in ../items/views/manifest.json. name = English display name, nameEs = Latin American Spanish.
